calls.title: Taskrabbit Roadmap Requests
calls.summary: The meeting centered on the TaskRabbit deal, highlighting a strategic shift toward interleaved experimentation as a primary focus, with features like Metro synthetic control and switchbacks also prioritized. TaskRabbit's internal timelines extend to January 31st, creating an opportunity for the team to build requested features. Although TaskRabbit ranks its feature priorities differently, internal discussions indicate a preference for interleaving as a long-term solution. The team aims to balance their commitments to TaskRabbit with other ongoing projects, emphasizing the need for clear communication about delivery timelines and capabilities to maintain competitive edge in the market.
calls.keywords: interleaved experimentation, synthetic control, switchbacks, TaskRabbit, roadmap, design partnership
